items.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024
items.q: Beck, who I played with on some other things

ctx.x: I bet you can. Yeah we’ve got six hours here so let’s get started.

The Aerosmith session, I just recorded one record for them and it was a kind of a larger horn section. I think there was two trombones on it and two or three trumpets, maybe © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-

three saxophones. And I just remember — oh what’s his last name — David Campbell who is the pop singer Beck who was a big star, still is I guess, Beck, who I played with on some other things but Beck, his dad is a really good arranger and he was kind of known as the arranger for the rock bands. He did some stuff for the Stones, he’s done lots of different folks. He was the arranger on it and thank goodness because it was party central in the booth.
